sources.entry: ServerHat - Free menu-bar app that runs your local dev servers. Claude Code and Codex can start, stop and read logs through its MCP server and local API, with your approval. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/getguruhat/serverhat-macos) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: ServerHat is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar app that starts, stops, restarts and monitors local dev servers, and exposes a local API and MCP server so Claude Code and Codex can control them with your approval.
summary.what_it_does: ServerHat runs commands such as npm run dev, python3 -m http.server or a Node script as named servers listed in a menu-bar menu, with Start, Stop, Restart, Open in browser and View logs actions. It shows each server's state (starting, ready, unhealthy, stopped, crashed, port in use) and notifies on crashes and port conflicts. Servers are defined in a readable servers.json file that is reloaded on edit, and can be imported from Claude Code's launch.json, a package.json, a Procfile or Docker Compose. Optional automatic retry after a crash uses exponential backoff with a configurable limit. A local HTTP API and built-in MCP server let Claude Code or Codex add and control servers, and any new or changed server command must be allowed by the user before it runs.
use_cases: run and stop local dev servers from the menu bar
let Claude Code or Codex start and read logs of a dev server
replace leaving Terminal tabs open for web servers
import a project's dev command into a managed server
monitor local servers for crashes and port conflicts
script local server control through a localhost API
how_to_run: Or download ServerHat-<version>-Installer.dmg from the latest release and drag ServerHat.app to Applications
Build from source: ./build-app.sh (requires macOS 13+ and Swift 5.9+)
Optional for AI agents: claude mcp add --scope user serverhat -- /Applications/ServerHat.app/Contents/MacOS/ServerHat --mcp
Optional for AI agents: codex mcp add serverhat -- /Applications/ServerHat.app/Contents/MacOS/ServerHat --mcp
Run swift test to run the test suite
stack: macOS menu bar app (AppKit-style menu UI)
notable: Built-in MCP server lets Claude Code and Codex start, stop, restart and read logs of servers as tools
Approval gate: servers added via API/MCP or whose command, args, cwd or env change must be allowed before they run
Each server runs in its own process group so Stop also ends child processes
Imports servers from .claude/launch.json, package.json scripts, Procfile web entries and Docker Compose files
No account and no analytics; API bound to localhost with token, Host and Origin checks
caveats: Apple silicon only, macOS 13 or later; the README lists no Intel support
The app is not notarized by Apple, so the first launch must be allowed manually in System Settings
Commands run directly without a shell, so pipes and && are not supported in command fields
MCP integration requires separately installing the Claude Code or Codex CLI
